findings.finding: validate_tangent validates only lengths and finiteness. It accepts all-zero energies and does not bind canonical energy bits, angular ordering, origin, clock, source identity or lambda.
findings.consequence: The positive test cannot establish energy/angle correspondence. Do not treat this helper as a family-admission gate.
findings.required_fix: Rename as a shape check or bind canonical labels and source/clock identity in a typed checked contract.

findings.finding: remap_lambda_fixed_theta rejects every canonical supported positive-redshift call at j=0: the canonical first energy is 10 eV, its redshifted interval lies at/below 10 eV. This check occurs even when incoming tangent is exactly zero.
findings.consequence: The helper cannot propagate the actual canonical state tangent. It fails closed, and has no executed result.
findings.required_fix: Implement owner guard-number/energy tangent ownership and supported threshold cases, or explicitly document this helper as unsupported for canonical owner grids. Do not silently discard nonzero guard tangents.

findings.finding: hh_root_matches binds stage/old/parent/dt/control/mode input identity only. HhRoot.root/image/scales are public mutable fields, so matching input identity does not authenticate the certificate gas/root contents. The caller preconditioner has no source/root identity binding.
findings.consequence: This draft cannot use root matching alone as proof provenance. Preconditioner identity absence is a provenance gap, not proof that an arbitrary preconditioner is mathematically invalid: strict verified inclusion/contraction could justify one.
findings.required_fix: Require a trusted matching certificate/provenance object or revalidate its certificate; record/recheck preconditioner association. Keep the private permit unavailable until separate admission.

findings.finding: The tangent draft still uses rounded scalar coefficient expressions inside point intervals, including energy-CHI and dt*c*nH, while the donor interval RHS constructs these through outward interval operations. The earlier ordinary row-norm accumulation has been repaired with Interval.add upper summation.
findings.consequence: A rigorous source-derivative/contraction enclosure has not been justified for these expression trees. No numerical false acceptance is demonstrated.
findings.required_fix: Match the certified RHS interval expression tree and independently validate residual and tangent inclusions before admission. No further row-summation fix is requested.

findings.finding: Public prepare_actual_birth accepts caller-provided nodes and configuration and does not call schemes/contract_valid or compare nodes to energy_nodes(c). Donor validate checks shape and state containment, not canonical node/source/clock identity.
findings.consequence: The fixed audit CLI uses canonical inputs safely; the helper alone is not a fail-closed original-owner identity interface.
findings.required_fix: Bind canonical nodes and the intended clock/source/configuration at the adapter boundary or name the helper as a generic pre-BE calculation.

findings.finding: The wrapper retains unpermitted donor science stepping APIs in the owner module, and main.rs reexports the donor crate. The new private token protects actual_* helpers but is not a universal compiler-level prohibition of scientific calls.
findings.consequence: No current CLI or focused test calls those functions. The binary private module is not an external library API; this is a future in-crate misuse risk, not observed unauthorized dispatch.
findings.required_fix: Restrict or segregate science-capable donor interfaces if a universal dispatch guard is claimed; test the real call boundary rather than only scientific_dispatch_requested().

findings.finding: The two failed build rows point to build.stderr, which was overwritten by the successful build. Their stored stderr SHA256 no longer matches that path.
findings.consequence: Historical command-to-artifact linkage is stale. Separate first_build.stderr and second_build.stderr retain failure evidence; current identity/source/binary/loader hashes match.
findings.required_fix: Use immutable per-attempt artifact paths or add a correction mapping historical rows to preserved first/second logs without rewriting history.

Below-threshold heat branch semantics: donor point photo_heat skips zero-rate channels, while donor interval RHS includes zero-cross-section channels. The new tangent also includes them and uses rounded energy-CHI. A negative excess with exactly zero sigma is not evidence of physical negative heating, but outward arithmetic may widen zero contributions. Require explicit threshold/zero-sigma derivative proof and meaningful tests; none of the 18 tests calls linked_tangent_stage.
Geometry/energy/angular derivative families, returned photon/guard/escape/ledger tangent propagation, actual half2 linked state and arbitrary theta/lambda enclosing-root admission remain OPEN.
